ST-01.title: Make the Daily Position Monitor's exit confirmation open the real exit flow
spec_references: docs/specs/frontend/pages/positions.md#Daily Position Monitor Exit Queue (v2.20 — ST-01, BLG-FE-226)
ST-01.notes: AC1: Position.update removed from base44Client.js; grep finds no PATCH /positions/{id} caller. AC2: Monitor 'Exit Selected' starts a queue of ExitModals with Stop Loss Hit / Risk-Off Signal pre-selected and the spec notes; each exit goes through POST /positions/{id}/exit (Position.exit) with shares, price, FX (SC-MEQ-01 asserts the body and that no PATCH is sent). AC3: a failed exit shows exit-error and keeps modal, values and queue; Cancel reopens the Monitor with the rest selected (SC-MEQ-02). AC4: both Playwright tests pass in CI, plus SC-MEQ-03 (two-position progress, decision record §6). CI on e9d4b699: Playwright E2E 38890449489 success; CI Pytest 38890449492 success; all 8 workflows success. Implementation note (no deviation): queries are invalidated after each recorded exit, not only after the last, so a cancelled queue's Monitor shows the already-exited positions gone. Deviation check: none. DoQ follow-up 68200248 (non-blocking finding 1): a Cancel during an in-flight exit no longer lets a late success advance the ended queue; restored Monitor selection cleared on close; SC-MEQ-04 added. commit_sha stays the story commit e9d4b699.
